content: Bass pedagogy sources (Scott's Bass Lessons, Berklee Take Note, Mastertemps) converge on: 5-10min warmup (fretboard runs/favorite riff), 10-15min play-along on a backing track for groove/timing, 10-15min theory+ear training (root-movement hearing, chord tones, modes). Root-movement ear training and transcription (learning by ear) are treated as the bass-specific priority over generic scale drilling.
